metaDesc: Explore Boh-IO, the AXEM-SX Sidecar console, Control Hub, Soft Depot, and the full technical architecture of the Digital Workshop.
heroSub: Every tool in AXEM-SX is crafted with intention — from the first boot to your deepest workflow.
bohioSubtitle: Bridge Our Humanities with Input & Output
bohioDesc: Most terminals are lonely places. Boh-IO changes that — without taking control away from you. It is a Sidecar console that pairs a standard Bash shell with a local, civic-minded AI apprentice.
bohioTriggerNote: ↑ triggers Sidecar, not executed in shell
bohioCmdExplain: Breaks down the command you just ran into plain English — no guessing what it did.
bohioCmdSafer: Suggests a less risky version of your last command before you regret it.
bohioCmdTeach: Delivers a mini-lesson on the tool you are using, with real-world examples.
bohioCmdUndo: Writes the corrective command to the Sidecar for you to review — it never executes automatically.
bohioCmdDryRun: Turns your prompt orange. Destructive commands (like rm) are rewritten to safe equivalents (like ls) so you can test syntax without fear.
privacyItem1: Powered by phi3:mini (3.8B parameters) via local Ollama — no cloud.
privacyItem2: Command history exists only in RAM for the duration of the open window.
privacyItem3: When you close Boh-IO, the entire conversation is wiped. No disk logs.
privacyItem4: The AI NEVER types into your shell — pane separation is absolute.
constraintsDesc: Boh-IO does not support full-screen TUI applications such as vim, htop, or tmux. These apps require cursor movements that Boh-IO intentionally blocks to keep the history linear and analyzable. Use the standard Konsole terminal for text editing and system monitoring.
tool1Desc: The AXEM-SX Control Hub curates and consolidates YaST alongside Cockpit — unlike other distributions that dropped YaST entirely. Workstation governance focused on storage, networking, logs, and users. Access at localhost:9090.
tool2Desc: Boh-IO — the civic-minded AI Sidecar. Offline, private, pedagogical. Tuned to answer questions about AXEM-SX and Linux — not to generate creative fiction.
tool3Desc: A curated software hub built for AXEM-SX. Discover, install, and manage applications with precision — no unnecessary dependencies, no noise.
archSub: What AXEM-SX inherits, what it changes, and why.
